results.title: 'If you want to stop BJP, talk to us': Owaisi open to alliance ahead of UP polls, targets govt over governance issues
results.description: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi stated his party is ready to work with others to prevent a third BJP term. He invited like-minded parties for discussions, emphasizing no single party can stop the BJP alone. Owaisi highlighted AIMIM's strengthened organization and grassroots leadership in Uttar Pradesh. He asserted the upcoming assembly elections will present different challenges and outcomes. The party is actively visiting constituencies to understand and address public issues.

results.title: UP CM Yogi Adityanath Hits Back At Ex-VP Hamid Ansari Over Hindu Right-Wing Remarks, Says Comments Tarnish India’s Image
results.description: UP CM Yogi Adityanath criticised former vice-president Hamid Ansari over his remarks on Hindu right-wing communalism and cultural nationalism. Yogi called the comments unfortunate, accused Ansari of tarnishing India’s image and said they disrespected Sanatan tradition. Ansari had cited Jawaharlal Nehru’s warning about Hindu right-wing communalism and urged opposition to cultural nationalism.

results.title: 570 Settlers Enter Al-Aqsa and Perform Talmudic Rituals
results.description: The PLO’s Jerusalem Affairs Department condemned the escalating violations of Al-Aqsa Mosque by Israeli authorities and settlers, saying that around 570 settlers had entered the mosque compound by 10 a.m. Sunday and performed prostrations and Talmudic rituals, coinciding with what is known as Yom Kippur. Large numbers of settlers had also gathered since early morning near the Mughrabi Gate ahead of entering the compound.
